notes.title: Free Playtest for Classic Card Games 3D (Version 1.5.8)
notes.notes:
A playtest for version 1.5.8 of [b]Classic Card Games 3D[/b] is now available. This beta version introduces new rule options:

[list]
[*] [b]Blackjack:[/b] Splitting hands is now possible.
[*] [b]Rummy:[/b] Multiple sets or sequences can be combined during the initial meld to meet the minimum point requirement. Additionally, card values, number of cards, and other rules can be customized.
[/list]
The playtest will be open for a few days and offers a preview of the major update planned for Q1 2025.

notes.title: Update 1.4.2 released
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.4.2[/h1]

-	New game [b]War[/b] added: With [b]Life and Death[/b] and [b]Peace[/b] variants
-	New game [b]Jass[/b] added: The most popular card game in [b]Switzerland[/b] with different variants
-	Option added: [b]Ascending or descending order[/b] of cards
-	Fullscreen Mode adaption improved: for Windows 10+11 monitor scaling 125% or higher
-	English localization and grammar fixes
-	Text and window overlap issues
-	Other fixes
-	Toggle FPS by typing "FPS", and Wireframe by "WIREX"

notes.title: Update 1.2 - main changes
notes.notes:
- Ultrawidescreen and Touchscreen bugfixes, adjustments
- Changing card deck on first start possible now (4 card designs and 10 card backs available)
- Poker crash when loading savegame fixed

notes.title: Version 1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Current version fixes and adds:
- crashes in german version in blackjack or 17+4/21 
- ultrawide and 5:4 resolutions: user interface bug, not clickable buttons
- in settings you can now activate automatically-savegame: each player's turn game state is saved in savegame AUTOSAVE and can be recovered
